title: Affine tensor pullback comparison of homology
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of quasi-coherent O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] [pqf-def-coherent], A=Gamma(S,top), B any commutative A-algebra, a an integer, and P the termwise global-sections complex. The A-module H^a(P tensor_A B) is isomorphic to the scalar restriction from B to A of the B-module of global sections of H^a(g*C), where g:Spec B -> S is Spec(algebraMap A B) followed by S.isoSpec.inv [def-pc-base-change]. Here tensor, scalar extension and pullback are ordinary, not derived. No vanishing, flatness or boundedness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: The tilde functor T is left adjoint and fully faithful. For a morphism f of B-modules, kernel(T.map f) is quasi-coherent by isQuasicoherent_kernel. Its affine counit is an isomorphism, so it lies in the image of T. Lift the kernel inclusion through full faithfulness, prove its composite with f is zero using map_injective, and transport the kernel limit cone through the counit. Full faithfulness reflects this limit. Thus T preserves every kernel. Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels gives finite-limit preservation; its left adjunction supplies finite-colimit preservation.

Let P be the section complex and Q its scalar extension to B. Restrict scalars from B to A. TensorProduct.comm followed by TensorProduct.congr for the identity scalar-restriction linear equivalence gives component isomorphisms P.X n tensor B -> restricted Q.X n. TensorProduct.induction_on proves compatibility with every differential (the pure tensor case is definitional), so isoOfComponents gives an isomorphism of these complexes.

Use affine_tensor_pullback_complex_comparison to identify T(Q) with the scheme pullback complex. The exact functors T and restrictScalars commute with homology by mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso. The affine unit tilde.toTildeGammaNatIso identifies Q.homology a with global sections of T(Q.homology a). Apply global sections to the inverse T-homology comparison and to the pullback complex comparison, then restrict scalars and compose with the tensor-commutation homology isomorphism. Only kernels of quasi-coherent objects and colimits preserved by the left adjoint are used; no separate quasi-coherent cokernel-closure lemma is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_tensor_pullback_homology_comparison (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S]
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) B] (a : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of Γ(S, ⊤) B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (.op ⊤) :
          S.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj C)).homology a) ≅
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) B)).obj
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of B)).obj
          ((((Modules.pullback
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) B)) ≫
              S.isoSpec.inv)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj C).homology a)))
